Technova Employee Handbook | Page 1 
TECHNOVA 
Employee Handbook 2026 

Effective Date: January 1, 2026 
Version: 1.0 
Approved By: Executive Leadership Team

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 2 
1.0 Welcome to Technova 
Welcome to the team! At Technova, we build simple, clear, and impactful technology solutions. 
We are thrilled to have you bring your unique talents, fresh perspective, and personal passion to 
our growing organization. 
1.1 A Message from Our CEO 
Our success relies entirely on the creativity, dedication, and collaborative spirit of our people. 
We work hard to foster an open environment where you feel genuinely valued, fully empowered, 
and constantly inspired to do your best work. This handbook serves as a foundational guide to 
understanding our daily culture, shared workplace policies, and the operational expectations we 
hold as a professional community. Please use it as a personal resource to help navigate your 
career journey with us. I look forward to working together and achieving great things. 
Warmly, 
[CEO Name] 
Chief Executive Officer 
1.2 Purpose of This Handbook 
This Employee Handbook provides you with essential everyday information about Technova. It 
acts as a central reference point for our company procedures, core benefits, and behavioral 
standards. While this guide is broad, it cannot anticipate every unique situation. The policies 
outlined here may change over time to adapt to new business goals and legal standards. You 
can always find the absolute latest version of this document on our internal HR portal. 
1.3 Our Commitment to You 
Technova is dedicated to building a supportive work experience centered around four 
foundational ideas: 
• 
Fairness: We treat every single employee with equal consistency, dignity, and respect. 
• 
Opportunity: We actively provide clear pathways for your long-term professional growth. 
• 
Inclusion: We value unique voices and ensure everyone feels safe contributing their ideas. 
• 
Well-being: We actively look out for your health, safety, and personal work-life balance. 
1.4 Employment-at-Will 
Employment at Technova is strictly on an at-will basis where permitted by law. This means that 
either you or Technova can choose to end the employment relationship at any time, for any 
reason, with or without prior notice. This handbook does not serve as an official employment 
contract and does not guarantee employment for any specific length of time.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 3 
2.0 Our Company, Our Culture 
Our workplace culture defines how we interact, solve problems, and grow together. We focus on 
transparency over bureaucracy and action over complex processes. 
2.1 Our Mission, Vision, and Values 
Our Mission is to simplify complex challenges using intelligent, modern technology solutions. 
Our Vision is to be a trusted global partner in engineering excellence, recognized for our 
commitment to quality and integrity. 
Our Core Values include: 
• 
Customer Obsession: We listen intently to our clients and design our solutions around their 
real needs. 
• 
Absolute Integrity: We focus on doing the right thing in every situation, keeping 
communications honest and clear. 
• 
Continuous Innovation: We actively seek simpler, smarter ways to solve everyday problems. 
• 
One Team Collaboration: We support one another across departments, celebrating our wins 
together. 
• 
Operational Excellence: We hold our work to high professional standards and always strive 
for exceptional outcomes. 
2.2 Our History 
Technova was founded with a foundational goal: to make advanced technology highly 
accessible and straightforward for businesses everywhere. What started as a dedicated small 
team has quickly evolved into a fast-growing enterprise serving a diverse, global client base. 
Our ongoing journey is fueled entirely by technical passion, iterative learning, and a shared 
commitment to sustainable growth. 
2.3 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) 
We know that a diverse team brings better ideas and a stronger workspace. DEI is a core part 
of who we are. We intentionally create an environment where every employee has a fair 
opportunity to thrive, regardless of their background. This mindset applies directly to our hiring, 
promotion, daily compensation, and training practices.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 4 
3.0 Your Employment 
This section covers the standard guidelines, classifications, and basic administrative 
components regarding your employment at Technova. 
3.1 Equal Employment Opportunity 
Technova is a dedicated Equal Opportunity Employer. We extend equal employment 
opportunities to all team members and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, 
national origin, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic 
protected by applicable local laws. 
3.2 Employee Classifications 
For benefits eligibility and clear payroll administration, we classify our roles as follows: 
• 
Full-Time: Team members scheduled to work our standard 40-hour workweek. They qualify 
for all company-sponsored benefits. 
• 
Part-Time: Team members scheduled to work fewer than 30 hours per week. Benefit 
eligibility for these roles is determined by individual employment agreements. 
• 
Exempt: Employees working in professional or managerial roles who are exempt from 
standard overtime pay provisions and receive a fixed salary. 
• 
Non-Exempt: Employees who are eligible for overtime pay for any hours physically worked 
beyond 40 within a standard workweek. 
3.3 Probationary Period 
Your first 90 days of employment serve as an introductory probationary period. This window 
gives both you and your manager a fair opportunity to see if the role is a great match for your 
skills and our culture. Regular feedback will be provided during this time. 
3.4 Your Employee File 
The HR Department securely maintains a personnel file for every employee. This file contains 
key documents like your original application, role updates, performance reviews, and salary 
history. You can review your file at any time by coordinating an appointment with HR.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 5 
3.5 Promotions and Transfers 
We love helping our team members grow. We actively encourage internal promotions and 
lateral transfers for open roles. Available positions are regularly published on our internal 
company job board. To apply for an internal transfer, you generally need to be in your current 
role for at least 12 months while maintaining a strong performance record. 
3.6 Performance Management 
Our performance review system is continuous and collaborative. It focuses on growth rather 
than rigid grading: 
• 
Goal Alignment: We set transparent annual goals that align with team objectives. 
• 
Regular Check-ins: Managers and employees have informal, ongoing discussions 
throughout the year. 
• 
Annual Review: A formal yearly conversation to evaluate key achievements, discuss 
feedback, and plan for your future career development. 
3.7 Separation of Employment 
When an employment relationship ends, we aim to make the transition clear and professional. 
• 
Voluntary Resignation: If you choose to leave Technova, we kindly ask that you submit a 
minimum of two weeks' written notice to your direct manager so we can transition your 
duties smoothly. 
• 
Involuntary Termination: In rare cases, the company may terminate employment due to 
prolonged poor performance, severe behavioral misconduct, or broader business 
restructuring.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 6 
4.0 Code of Conduct and Ethics 
We maintain a respectful, honest, and ethical workspace. This code outlines how we expect our 
team to represent themselves and Technova every day. 
4.1 Professional Conduct 
We expect every employee to act professionally and treat colleagues, clients, and partners with 
courtesy. Any disruptive, dishonest, or illegal behavior will not be tolerated and can result in 
disciplinary action up to termination. 
4.2 Anti-Harassment and Anti-Bullying 
Technova is committed to providing a workspace entirely free from harassment, discrimination, 
and bullying. We strictly prohibit unwelcome conduct or unfair treatment based on any legally 
protected personal traits. Bullying behavior that compromises an employee's well-being or 
safety has no place here. 
If you witness or experience harassment, report it immediately to HR or your manager. We 
investigate all reports promptly and confidentially. Technova strictly prohibits retaliation against 
anyone making a good-faith report. 
4.3 Conflicts of Interest 
A conflict of interest happens when your personal activities or relationships interfere with your 
ability to make objective decisions for Technova. You must avoid these situations. Common 
examples include: 
• 
Holding a significant financial stake in a direct competitor or vendor. 
• 
Using company resources or your professional title for personal financial gain. 
• 
Directly supervising or hiring a close family member without explicit HR approval. 
Please disclose any potential conflicts to HR as soon as you become aware of them.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 7 
4.4 Gifts and Entertainment 
Exchanging modest business courtesies can build good relationships, but they must never 
influence objective business choices. 
• 
Receiving Gifts: You may accept minor, token items of nominal value. You must never 
accept cash, gift cards, or expensive personal items. 
• 
Business Entertainment: Standard meals and basic entertainment are acceptable if they 
have a direct, clear business purpose. 
4.5 Confidentiality and Intellectual Property 
While working at Technova, you will handle proprietary information, including code bases, 
customer data, and strategic roadmaps. You must keep this information completely secure and 
never share it outside the company. This duty continues even after your employment with us 
ends. All software, designs, ideas, and documentation you create as part of your job belong 
exclusively to Technova. 
4.6 Whistleblower Policy 
We strictly follow all relevant laws and ethics. If you see illegal practices or severe policy 
violations, report them immediately to HR or Legal. We will protect you completely; we do not 
tolerate any form of retaliation against employees who speak up in good faith. 
4.7 Ethics Case Study: Managing Conflicts 
Scenario: A procurement lead needs to pick a vendor for office equipment. Their sibling 
runs a local supply business that submits a competitive bid. 

Analysis: Even if the sibling's bid offers excellent value, the family connection creates a 
clear appearance of a conflict of interest. 

Correct Action: The procurement lead must immediately notify their manager and HR in 
writing. They must remove themselves entirely from the evaluation and voting process so 
the company can make an unbiased decision.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 8 
5.0 Workplace Policies 
Our daily operational guidelines ensure an organized, safe, and productive environment for all 
teams. 
5.1 Working Hours, Breaks, and Overtime 
• 
Standard Hours: Our core business operating hours are 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, Monday 
through Friday, though hours may adjust slightly based on specific project needs. 
• 
Rest Breaks: Non-exempt team members receive a paid 15-minute break for every four 
hours worked, alongside a standard 30-minute unpaid meal break for shifts over five hours. 
Coordinate break times with your team to maintain smooth operations. 
• 
Overtime: Non-exempt employees receive overtime pay at 1.5 times their standard hourly 
rate for hours worked beyond 40 in a week. All overtime must be pre-approved by a 
manager. 
5.2 Attendance and Punctuality 
Reliable attendance keeps our projects running smoothly. If you expect to be late or absent, 
inform your manager directly before your scheduled start time. Unexcused, repetitive absences 
can lead to disciplinary action. 
5.3 Dress Code 
Our standard daily dress code is business casual. We trust your professional judgment to dress 
appropriately for a modern office. 
• 
Appropriate Clothing: Tailored trousers, khakis, neat jeans, casual button-downs, polo shirts, 
and blouses. 
• 
Items to Avoid: Ripped clothing, sportswear, beach footwear, or clothing featuring offensive 
language or graphics. 
• 
Client Engagements: Wear formal business attire when meeting face-to-face with clients or 
representing Technova at industry events.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 9 
5.4 Health and Safety 
Your physical well-being is our priority. Report all hazards, faulty equipment, or injuries to HR 
immediately. Take time to understand the emergency exit layouts and evacuation plans for your 
specific building. 
5.5 Drug and Alcohol-Free Workplace 
To keep our team safe and productive, we strictly prohibit the use, possession, or distribution of 
illegal drugs and alcohol on company property during work hours. Responsible consumption is 
permitted only at approved company-hosted evening social events where alcohol is formally 
served. 
5.6 Use of Company Technology and Assets 
Laptops, communication channels, and internet access provided by Technova are business 
tools. 
• 
Personal Use: Brief, occasional personal use is fine as long as it never impacts your work 
output or violates company security. 
• 
Privacy Expectations: Technova maintains the right to review and monitor company-owned 
networks and hardware. Employees should have no expectation of privacy regarding data 
created or stored on company systems. 
• 
Security Rules: Keep your devices secure, do not share passwords, and strictly follow our 
standard IT security protocols. 
5.7 Social Media Policy 
We respect your personal freedom to post online, but your words can impact Technova's 
reputation. 
• 
Protect Data: Never share private company details, source code, or internal plans online. 
• 
Be Respectful: Avoid posting content that discriminates against or defames Technova, your 
coworkers, or our clients. 
• 
Use Disclaimer: When discussing tech industry trends publicly, clearly state: 'The views 
expressed are my own and do not represent my employer.' 
5.8 Social Media Case Study: Online Activity 
Scenario: An employee posts a message on a public forum complaining about an 
unreleased system update, naming the project directly. 

Analysis: This violates our policy by disclosing internal project details and presenting

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 10 
Technova in a negative public light. 

Correct Action: Project frustrations must be raised internally through managers or HR 
channels rather than shared on public platforms.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 11 
6.0 Compensation and Benefits 
We provide competitive compensation packages that match industry benchmarks and reflect 
your professional skills, experience, and performance. 
6.1 Payroll Details 
Employees are paid on a consistent, predictable schedule. Direct deposit is mandatory for all 
team members, and detailed digital pay stubs are accessible at any time through our secure 
HRIS portal. 
6.2 Benefits Overview 
Technova provides a robust benefits plan to eligible full-time staff, which includes 
comprehensive medical insurance, retirement savings matches, life insurance options, and 
wellness program support. Full enrollment details can be accessed via the benefits portal. 
6.3 Travel Reimbursements 
The company reimburses all reasonable, pre-approved costs incurred during business travel. 
Ensure you submit detailed expense reports along with valid receipts within the required 
timeframe after your trip. 
7.0 Leave and Time Off 
We believe taking time off is vital for long-term productivity and personal health. 
• 
Paid Time Off (PTO): Full-time employees receive an annual allotment of PTO for vacations 
and personal time, scaling upwards with your tenure. 
• 
Sick Leave: We provide dedicated annual paid sick days to take care of your own health or 
look after an ill family member. 
• 
Holidays: Technova observes standard paid public holidays each calendar year, with the 
official schedule published every January. 
• 
Special Leave: We provide structured guidelines for parental leave, bereavement leave, and 
civic duties like jury duty.

Technova Employee Handbook | Page 12 
8.0 Employee Development 
Continuous learning is central to our engineering mindset. We actively invest in your 
professional growth. 
8.1 Training and Development 
We support your career progression through multiple channels: 
• 
Giving you full access to digital learning and technical training platforms. 
• 
Organizing internal technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions. 
• 
Sponsoring attendance at key industry conferences and certification programs. 
8.2 Tuition Assistance 
Eligible employees can apply for financial assistance to complete degrees or professional 
certifications that directly align with their career path at Technova. Check the HR portal to view 
application rules and reimbursement caps. 
9.0 Problem Resolution and Communication 
We believe in open dialogue and fixing workplace problems quickly and transparently. 
9.1 Open Door Policy 
We maintain an active Open Door Policy. We encourage you to discuss your ideas, career 
goals, or workplace problems directly with your manager. If you feel uncomfortable doing so, 
you are always welcome to bring your thoughts to higher management or the HR team. 
9.2 Grievance Procedure 
When informal talks do not resolve an issue, you can file a formal complaint through our HR 
department. This ensures a structured, neutral, and fair investigation to find a clear solution. 
10.0 Acknowledgment of Receipt 
Every employee must sign an acknowledgment form on their first day or after major policy 
changes. This confirms you have received the handbook, understand where to find company 
policies, and agree to follow these workplace guidelines during your time with Technova.
